name: Radar Amplifier - Ballistics
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized ST positioner that allows ally STs to gain positions and guide missiles to accurately hit targets within range. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Ballistics capability.

61182.name: TacW Guidance II · Ballistics
61182.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) area to become a valid attack zone for allies' Missile and Rocket attacks.
When engaging in combat with a target at Ideal Range, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
